title: Azusawa Kohane — With The First Sunrise At My Back〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Card: With The First Sunrise At My Back（4★）

rows.Line: Shrine Hall

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Alright, we made our wishes and got a nice start to the new year! Not bad at all!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I feel the same.
I'm also happy that we were able to make this visit together.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah, you never know when an experience like this will come in handy.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: It even comes with a “great blessing” as the cherry on top! That means Vivid BAD SQUAD's really gonna rock the city this year!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Says the only person who actually drew a “great blessing”...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Oh, that reminds me...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I don't think I read the part about education in my fortune yet.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Education?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Yeah... Oh, thank goodness!
“Your efforts will be rewarded”...!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? I wonder what mine says...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Let's see... “Fortune favors the studious”...! Awesome! That means I won't fail anything, right?!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I'm not so sure about that.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: It all depends on how you interpret that phrase, no? You could very well run into some trouble if you don't study enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: *Gasp*...!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: I agree. I have a hard time reading this as not having to study at all.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, duh. There's no way you'll get good grades if you don't actually work for it.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Grr...!
Fine, Mr. Smartypants, what did yours say?!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
I don't remember...
Honestly, who actually takes this stuff seriously?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Incidentally, I got the same thing as Azusawa. What does yours say, Akito?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh oh...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh? What's it say? Tell us!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: “Do not cut corners”... It may be wise to not cram or only study the bare minimum this year for tests and quizzes.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Alright, I get it. Sheesh.
I promise not to cut any corners, so quit giving me that look.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Hehe. It's so interesting how these fortunes go right along with someone's personality!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I really liked yours, Kohane.
“Follow your heart.” It's so you!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. You think so?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, what did your guys' part about “Ambitions” say?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Mine says, “Slow and steady wins the race.”
Not really what I wanted to hear, but I guess I don't really have a choice.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
I got, “Your patience will be rewarded.”
I suppose that means I have something to look forward to now.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Mine's... “Keep moving forward even when you feel lost.”

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I actually really like that!
It's like I'm being told to not give up even when things don't look so great.

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, I agree.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, it's never easy to just go your own way just based on my own experiences...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: But it's so nice that we're getting such words of encouragement from these!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Yeah! Let's keep doing our best, Kohane!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Oh, I think that's one of the trees where we can tie these up. Why don't we go do that?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, let's.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line:
Okay...
That should be tight enough.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: Oh, Kohane, I'm gonna tie mine next to yours! There! Nice and tight!

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Alright, I think it's about time we headed back to practice... Hm? There's something written on all these wooden plaques... Oh, are these everybody's wishes?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Yeah, looks like it.
A whole lot of them too.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: These are always so fun to look at because of all the different things people are wishing for!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah, I agree. It's almost like every sort of wish you can think of too.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hey... Why don't we hang some up?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Our own wish plaques?

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Yeah. We all have the same wish, so I was thinking that we could hang one up for all of us.

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
That's an awesome idea!
I'll go get one right now!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: A-An, wait...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: One plaque for four people? Is that allowed...?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: I've never heard of any rules saying that each person has to have their own plaque so...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
I'm back!
We can each have our own quarter.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Wait, that sounds more like a thank you card...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
Details! Details!
Anyway, Kohane, start us off!

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What? Me?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line: Yes, it was your idea, so I believe you should go first as well.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: O-Okay...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: (I want to put on an event that surpasses RAD WEEKEND...!)

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Okay, done...!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That's tiny. I can barely read that...

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: What?!

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line: What are you talking about? Can't you see how adorable that is? Anyway, me next!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: And you're taking up way too much space...

rows.Speaker: An
rows.Line:
It's easy to read, right?
Also, if you're gonna complain so much, why don't you show us how it's done?

rows.Speaker: Toya
rows.Line:
Hehe.
You'll be able to tell that it's our wish plaque from a mile away.

rows.Speaker: Kohane
rows.Line: Hehe. Definitely!
